scientific_integrity: The global convergence and positive-probability escape statements follow from an explicit proof; finite numerical and rational checks corroborate but do not certify infinite claims.
scientific_limitations: Identity/orthonormal equations only; the batch model requires all workers to read the same frozen residual and apply every duplicate correction without rereading or deduplication.
No guarantee for live reads, partially overlapping threads, nonorthogonal equations, finite precision, or typical real-hardware failure frequencies.
Positive-probability divergence is not a claim that most sample paths diverge; no classification of all critical-parameter non-axis starts is given.
title: Sharp adaptive-sampling stability discontinuity under frozen-snapshot Kaczmarz batches
